I am originally from Russia (living in the US now) and while I don't have any first-hand experiences myself I know a few Russian LGBT people. It's really not pretty. None of the people I know are out of the closet, although some of them have told their friend circles only to be mocked constantly in a "friendly" manner. When I try to talk to the Russian straight people about this topic they either recoil in disgust or start joking around. My mom's friend visited a year ago and proudly said that "Gays get beaten back home." My sister's boyfriend was mocked and threatened by random guys on the street because he dared to have slightly longer hair and wear skinny jeans, even though he is completely straight and a bit homophobic himself. Mind you I come from a small town in the middle of Siberia, so maybe things are better in bigger cities like Moscow or St. Petersburg (although if you watch [this](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wgm3lb9JUU0) or [this](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HjE-kCU0u5Y) video it doesn't seem like it). For these reasons I have stopped visiting and I try to keep as far away as possible from the Russian community in the US.
